<!-- pr-reviewer: f11e1a8345bb7ca8f89674a55e1450f18d4c05ed -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The Donate button meets the requirements of #2385. The button stays enabled in both shells. The funding URL has one constant. Native launch failures show a message with the URL. The browser shell requests a new tab. The action does not change the document or its history.

I checked the current upstream/main rules at `3e47b898b0148727979ff4a509f33a742f80ff1d`. The trial merge needed no changes: this head already contains that main. I ran the checks locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2417`. No GitHub runner was used.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all nine steps:

| UI suite | Passed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|
| lib | 1061 | 6 |
| boundary | 3 | 0 |
| boundary_picks | 7 | 0 |
| sinker_setup | 2 | 0 |
| tap_hand | 3 | 0 |
| theme_example | 3 | 0 |
| theme_files | 15 | 0 |
| waterjet_tool | 1 | 0 |

The gate built the selected test targets with `--no-run`. All eight Donate tests passed. Total: 1095 passed, zero failed, six existing tests ignored. An earlier build stopped with signal 15 before the tests started. The complete second run passed.

`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

The before and after images load and show the requested change. Their commit is the head of the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. The Tabler heart has a source record and an MIT notice. No snapshot PNG or machining golden changed.

Requested before merge: none.

This change does not affect posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge and collision checks. No mutation was required for this UI review. I did not change the code. The tests check launcher errors and browser requests without opening a real browser. Windows, macOS and wasm compilation were not checked here. Thread creation failure was not forced.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
